description: This file defines the RepeatingAlarmFragment class, which is a Fragment for an Android application that sets up a repeating alarm using AlarmManager when a menu item is selected. It includes handling of intents, PendingIntents, and system services, specifically managing alarm scheduling with setRepeating.

classes.name: RepeatingAlarmFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides functionality to set a repeating alarm that triggers a specified intent periodically.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, enabling options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection; when a specific item is selected, sets up a repeating alarm via AlarmManager.
